api-barrel.definition: An entry module imports or reexports implementations as the public API.
api-barrel.signature: FxTS has 39 outgoing imports at src/index.ts; Solid export-star syntax has no corresponding Imports edges.
api-barrel.localization: Entrypoint can be a required modification while the requested new implementation is absent.
api-barrel.limit: An entrypoint is not necessarily a runtime facade; export aliases are not import edges.

ast-visitor.definition: An algorithm dispatches or traverses according to AST node kinds.
ast-visitor.signature: Direct helper Imports in React; ESLint visitor file can be import-isolated by resolution refusal.
ast-visitor.localization: Distinctive rule names retrieve the visitor while generic helpers remain low ranked.
ast-visitor.limit: Imports do not encode AST selectors, callback order or node semantics.

configuration-policy.definition: A data key or delegated method selects a behavior within a shared algorithm.
configuration-policy.signature: Renovate has direct package-helper imports; Carbon separates policy data from styled component.
configuration-policy.localization: Behavior descriptions can identify a policy consumer but miss policy data or sibling implementations.
configuration-policy.limit: A type dependency is not evidence of runtime strategy selection.

dependency-injection.definition: A caller supplies a capability or a configuration manager constructs it.
dependency-injection.signature: CLI imports expose the composition root; Solid also registers config and instantiates DEFAULT_APP.
dependency-injection.localization: Public behavior may require both assembly and implementation files.
dependency-injection.limit: Imports/Calls cannot encode argument binding or config-to-implementation selection.

event-subscription.definition: A producer emits named events consumed by registered callbacks.
event-subscription.signature: Synthetics base reporter imports runner; Obsidian cache subscribes to external metadata events.
event-subscription.localization: An event failure can live in producer, callback, shared type or formatter.
event-subscription.limit: The import direction is not the event-flow direction; no Emits/Handles relation exists.

external-adapter.definition: A module translates calls or objects between a local interface and an external protocol.
external-adapter.signature: Pino stream wrapper has source-confirmed delegation; not an admitted inter-file call to the concrete destination.
external-adapter.localization: A stack trace in a dependency may correspond to a local wrapper or contract mismatch.
external-adapter.limit: External endpoints and computed receivers are not resolved repository targets.

generated-boundary.definition: Source code produces code, or an output explicitly identifies itself as generated.
generated-boundary.signature: Defines identifies generateRulesIndex; generation itself is not one of the six relations.
generated-boundary.localization: Gold may contain build scripts and generated registries besides a recognizable feature file.
generated-boundary.limit: A directory or header alone does not establish the exact producer; ESLint producer is directly inspected.

hook-registry.definition: A dictionary stores named implementations or callbacks selected elsewhere.
hook-registry.signature: Reporter dictionary plus selection site; Firebase mutable registry also exposes get/start.
hook-registry.localization: A new feature often requires registration in addition to its implementation.
hook-registry.limit: High degree does not establish a registry; keys and lookup behavior do.

initialization-protocol.definition: Several operations must be assembled with explicit preconditions or ordering.
initialization-protocol.signature: Shared location precondition is visible via two incoming imports.
initialization-protocol.localization: Issue may describe one setup action while requiring parallel setup paths and shared metadata.
initialization-protocol.limit: Import co-use does not encode precondition, time or shared mutable state.

plugin-chain.definition: Applicable extensions transform a value successively.
plugin-chain.signature: bundle.js calls plugin methods; source loop proves chaining, Imports alone does not.
plugin-chain.localization: Resource errors span orchestration, plugin and shared utility.
plugin-chain.limit: Dynamic plugin discovery and order are omitted; this is one repository, not replicated evidence.

shared-utility.definition: Multiple source modules use the same reusable operation implementation.
shared-utility.signature: resource-utils.js has 22 incoming imports and one outgoing import in w49.
shared-utility.localization: Forward import can find a missed helper; reverse import can reveal sibling affected consumers.
shared-utility.limit: High fan-in can instead be test scaffolding or types, with little issue relevance.

transformation-pipeline.definition: Ordered stages convert an intermediate representation before output.
transformation-pipeline.signature: InstanceExporter setAssignedValues explicitly expands and normalizes rules; only some dependencies are admitted.
transformation-pipeline.localization: One stage may be easy to retrieve even in a complex compiler-like organization.
transformation-pipeline.limit: Calls and imports do not identify pass order or data flowing between stages.
